name: LIB/core/altar
tags: altar shrine candle cloth temple dungeon
desc: A stone altar on a low plinth, a cloth runner draped over its top and front, two lit candles at the back.

name: LIB/core/anvil
tags: anvil smithy forge iron tool
desc: A blacksmith's iron anvil with a tapered horn, set on a squat wooden stump.

name: LIB/core/banner
tags: banner flag cloth wall heraldry dungeon
desc: A pointed cloth banner with a gold emblem hanging from an iron rod on two wall brackets; back at z 0.

name: LIB/core/barrel
tags: barrel wood storage cargo tavern dungeon
desc: An oak barrel of upright staves bound by four iron hoops, closed by a plank lid.

name: LIB/core/bench
tags: bench seat wood tavern furniture inn
desc: A long plank bench on two notched trestle legs joined by a stretcher; seats two or three.

name: LIB/core/bone_pile
tags: bones skull remains crypt dungeon scatter
desc: Three long bones and a skull scattered on the floor, about 1 m across.

name: LIB/core/brazier
tags: brazier fire light iron dungeon camp
desc: An iron brazier: a wide bowl of glowing coals on three splayed legs, lighting the room.

name: LIB/core/cage
tags: cage prison iron bars jail dungeon
desc: A hanging-style iron cage set on the floor: barred sides, a pyramid roof with a ring, a padlocked front.

name: LIB/core/candle_cluster
tags: candle light wax table shrine tavern
desc: A cluster of wax candles of different heights on a small pewter plate, giving a soft warm light.

name: LIB/core/chains
tags: chains manacles iron wall prison dungeon
desc: Two iron chains with manacles hanging from rings on wall plates; back on the wall at z 0.

name: LIB/core/chair
tags: chair seat wood tavern furniture inn
desc: A wooden tavern chair: plank seat at 45 cm, four legs, a raked back with top rail and splat.

name: LIB/core/column
tags: column pillar stone temple dungeon hall
desc: A 2.8 m stone column: square plinth, round moulded base, tapering shaft and a flared capital.

name: LIB/core/column_broken
tags: column pillar ruin broken stone dungeon
desc: A snapped stone column, 1.2-1.8 m, on its plinth; its fallen drum lies beside it with a few chips.

name: LIB/core/crate_stack
tags: crate box wood storage cargo dungeon
desc: A plank crate with dark edge bands and braces; half the seeds stack a smaller crate on top.

name: LIB/core/crystal_cluster
tags: crystal glow magic cave light dungeon
desc: Two to four glowing hexagonal crystals, 0.4-1.2 m, leaning out of a rock base; lights the room in the accent colour.

name: LIB/core/fence
tags: fence wood rail town farm modular
desc: A 2 m post-and-rail fence segment; end posts sit on x=+-100 so segments join end to end.

name: LIB/core/market_stall
tags: market stall awning produce town shop
desc: A market stall: plank counter with crates of apples, oranges and cabbages under a striped awning.

name: LIB/core/mushroom_cluster
tags: mushroom fungus glow cave plant dungeon
desc: Two to four giant cave mushrooms, 0.3-1.1 m, with pale stems and glowing spotted caps in the accent colour.

name: LIB/core/rock_cluster
tags: rock boulder stone cave dungeon scatter
desc: Three rounded boulders of varied size huddled on the floor; stone tinted by the room's wall colour.

name: LIB/core/rubble_pile
tags: rubble ruin stone debris dungeon scatter
desc: Fallen masonry: squared stone blocks, one tipped on the others, a broken wedge and scattered chips.

name: LIB/core/sack
tags: sack grain burlap storage farm cargo
desc: A plump burlap grain sack, its floppy neck tied with rope under a flared, bunched top.

name: LIB/core/shelf
tags: shelf bookcase books wood library furniture
desc: A tall oak bookcase for a wall: five shelves of leaning books, jars and a lying stack; back at z 0.

name: LIB/core/signpost
tags: signpost sign road wood town crossroads
desc: A wooden crossroads signpost: a capped post with two arrow boards pointing different ways, stones at its foot.

name: LIB/core/stalagmite
tags: stalagmite spire cave stone rock dungeon
desc: A tapering cave spire, 1-2 m, rising from a low skirt of stone with smaller spires at its foot.

name: LIB/core/table
tags: table wood tavern furniture inn
desc: A sturdy tavern table: an oak plank top on four square legs with aprons and an H-stretcher.

name: LIB/core/urn
tags: urn pot ceramic clay storage dungeon
desc: A terracotta urn on a small foot with a dark painted band, a flared lip and two loop handles.

name: LIB/core/wall_torch
tags: torch light fire wall iron dungeon
desc: An iron wall bracket holding a wooden torch tilted out from the wall, its flame lighting the room; back at z 0.

name: LIB/core/well
tags: well water stone town village square
desc: A round cobblestone well under a little shingled wooden roof, with a crank, rope and hanging bucket.
